def find_password_parts(s):
    n = len(s)
    max_length = 0
    best_parts = []

    # Check all possible middle parts
    for i in range(n):
        if (n - i) % 2 == 1:  # Middle part must have odd length
            middle_length = n - i
            prefix_length = i // 2
            suffix_length = (n - i - 1) // 2

            # Check if the prefix and suffix are equal
            if s[:prefix_length] == s[-suffix_length:]:
                current_length = prefix_length + middle_length + suffix_length
                if current_length > max_length:
                    max_length = current_length
                    best_parts = [
                        (1, prefix_length),
                        (prefix_length + 1, middle_length),
                        (prefix_length + middle_length + 1, suffix_length)
                    ]

    # Remove empty parts
    best_parts = [part for part in best_parts if part[1] > 0]

    # Print the result
    print(len(best_parts))
    for part in best_parts:
        print(part[0], part[1])
